title: a16z Goes Global: Why American Tech Must Lead the World

reader_summary.headline: When AI becomes the interface for everything, every tool we have.
reader_summary.overview: When AI becomes the interface for everything, every tool we have, every technology we use is going to be built on these models. And the models are not objective, they have opinions. They have strong opinions on things like history, on culture, on values.

key_points.text: And those are very different depending where you are.
key_points.evidence_quote: And those are very different depending where you are.

key_points.text: Turns is no longer just the size of a military.
key_points.evidence_quote: Turns is no longer just the size of a military, it's the pace of innovation in reacting to cheap software built tech that adversaries may be using whether they're a country, criminal or terrorist group.

key_points.text: And those technologies today are not being built by government, they're being built by the private sector.
key_points.evidence_quote: And those technologies today are not being built by government, they're being built by the private sector.

key_points.text: Products and technology travel faster than companies can.
key_points.evidence_quote: Products and technology travel faster than companies can.

thesis: The speakers argue that as AI becomes the universal interface for all tools and technologies, the models powering them embed non-objective opinions on history, culture, and values that vary significantly by region. Consequently, the United States must lead globally to preserve its unique cultural and economic advantages while ensuring that the world runs on Western technology to prevent other nations from being colonized in cyberspace.
